entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, fell to 9 centimetres on 8 November, with a 5 centimetre low overnight
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 9 centimetres at 06:15 on 8 November, down from 21 centimetres on 7 November. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, reading of 8 November 2026

entry.title: Queensland's heatwave warning was raised to Extreme on 7 November after Mount Isa spent five days at or above 40 °C
entry.summary: Mount Isa recorded 40.2 to 41.6 °C from 1 to 5 November and Julia Creek 42.2 °C. Queensland's Extreme warning runs to 10 November, and the Northern Territory has an Extreme warning for Tiwi. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Queensland heatwave warning IDQ21013, issued 7 November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, daily weather observations, Mount Isa and Julia Creek, November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Northern Territory heatwave warning, 7 November 2026
